comment.text: ACVR1 R258 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; High-grade glioma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record.
